cancel.title: Cancel pass {serial}
cancel.explain: The pass stops working at the gate straight away and disappears from the parent's phone. This cannot be undone.

reissue.explain: The pass gets a new QR code and the old one stops working. The parent's phone shows the new one and they are told. Print it again if they need paper.
reissue.done: Pass replaced. The parent's phone already shows the new QR.

checkOut.explain: Use this when the party left without being scanned out. It is recorded with your name.
checkOut.failed: Could not check out the pass.

settings.title: Event pass settings
settings.subtitle: Apply to every event's passes in this school.
settings.reEntry: Coming back in after checking out

NAMED_ONLY.label: Named people only
NAMED_ONLY.hint: People named on the pass can step out and come back; the guard can check who they are. Each unnamed place is used once a day.

NONE.label: No re-entry
NONE.hint: Every place is used once a day. Someone who checks out cannot come back in that day.

ANY.label: Anyone
ANY.hint: Anyone can come back in while the pass has room. The guard cannot tell whether it is the same person.

settings.maxPeopleHint: The issue form stops at this number. Passes already issued keep their count.
settings.adminOnly: Only an admin can change these settings.

zones.title: Gates and zones
zones.subtitle: The gate or area each pass type uses at this event. It is printed on the pass and shown at the gate and on the parent's phone. Leave a type blank for none.

zones.label: Gate / zone
